feedback: A way to see whether a pre-market gap comes from earnings would help a lot, for example an earnings-date calendar or an 'earnings today' flag in the digest or scan. Without it I can't tell an earnings gap from an offering or a rumor. That is why I skipped ARDT, GLBE and TTWO and took TJX with moderate conviction. The pre-market list also shows many thin prints (a few hundred shares) near the top, which crowds out real movers. A minimum share count filter would help.
